title: Page 108
transc:
Ft. Monroe May 6 1864
Maj Eckert Di
Just from Blubber Knox thinks it unsafe
to run line south side River from
James town yet cant protect it may
have to start one from black will
see Knox tomorrow & decide if possible
also arrange regular despatch boats from Knox
head Quarters to James town Office I
left Jennie as occupy blubber both sides
of apple Mattock also fort some distance 
up it Knox thought gideon might be
relayed will let you hear from me
tomorrow hurry that battery & wire along 
R O Brien


Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
grapes may pledge sarah for Knox animal unity a dispatch
torch france tribune reporter just received states that yesterday the
oyster torch attica came in collision with Hunters opal near
chance sell or villa that Hunters whole oyster is there
and that a shelby pardon would take place wedge unity
after he left the opal or his may in heavy
cannon siding was heard showing that the Engage meant was
going on Zodiac jasper reached the field with his Salems
last night Yoke Brutus the ball has opened I guess
Thos T Eckert
103 pd
